O.outcome_detail: change in ICT-related career aspirations between 2018 and 2022

cells.quote: Results show a global but uneven increase  in ICT career aspirations. Digital skills emerge as the strongest and most consistent predictor, while teacher support plays a complementary role. Autonomy shows weaker, context -dependent effects.
cells.note: Country-level observational analysis using PISA 2018 and 2022 indicators; no printed coefficient or effect size is provided in the study text shown.

O.outcome_detail: vocabulary knowledge levels and gains from kindergarten through fourth grade

cells.quote: We find evidence for a developmental delay, such that students with an LD had similar levels and gains in their vocabulary knowledge relative to typically developing students, but these students started much lower in their reading comprehension skills and did not catch up to their typically developing peers.
cells.note: The text reports similarity but does not report an equivalence test or adequate power, so the direction is coded ns rather than 0.
